title: 🔥 LOVE THE LORD YOUR GOD—NOT JUST YOUR CHURCH! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 LOVE THE LORD YOUR GOD—NOT JUST YOUR CHURCH! 🔥
📖 Matthew 22:37 – "Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind."
One of the greatest deceptions today is that many people believe they are following Jesus, but in reality, they are just attached to their church.

🚨 Many people are more in love with their denomination than with Jesus Himself.
🚨 Many serve their church faithfully but have no real relationship with God.
🚨 Many defend their pastors but don’t even read the Bible for themselves.

👉 Are you loving God with all your heart, soul, and mind?
❌ Or are you just religiously loyal to a system?
🔥 JESUS DIDN’T SAY, "LOVE YOUR CHURCH." HE SAID, "LOVE YOUR GOD!"
Let’s expose this dangerous deception and return to the TRUE greatest commandment!

🔥 1. WHY DID JESUS COMMAND US TO LOVE GOD FIRST?
📖 Deuteronomy 6:5 – "Love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your strength."

When Jesus was asked about the greatest commandment, He didn’t say:
❌ "Go to church every Sunday."
❌ "Be loyal to your denomination."
❌ "Follow your pastor blindly."
🔥 He said, "LOVE THE LORD YOUR GOD!"

✔️ With ALL your heart (your desires, passions, and emotions).
✔️ With ALL your soul (your identity, eternity, and spirit).
✔️ With ALL your mind (your thoughts, wisdom, and understanding).
👉 If your love for God is not FIRST in your life, then everything else is idolatry!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A man spends all his time in church, serving in ministries, giving tithes, and following traditions.
But he never prays, never seeks God personally, and has no real relationship with Christ.
🚨 That is religion, not love for God!
🔥 CHRISTIANITY IS ABOUT A RELATIONSHIP—NOT JUST A CHURCH ROUTINE!

🔥 2. WHY DO PEOPLE LOVE THEIR CHURCH MORE THAN GOD?
📖 Isaiah 29:13 – "These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me."

Sadly, many Christians today have been misled into believing that:
✔️ Being active in church = A strong relationship with God.
✔️ Following church traditions = Faithfulness to Christ.
✔️ Being loyal to a pastor = Obedience to Jesus.
🚨 BUT THIS IS A DANGEROUS LIE!
🔥 CHURCH ATTENDANCE IS NOT A SUBSTITUTE FOR A RELATIONSHIP WITH GOD!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Some people think going to church is enough to be saved.
👉 But Judas was with Jesus every day and still betrayed Him!
🚨 YOU CAN SIT IN CHURCH EVERY WEEK AND STILL GO TO HELL!

🔥 3. JESUS DIDN’T DIE TO BUILD A CHURCH ORGANIZATION—HE CAME TO RESTORE RELATIONSHIP WITH GOD!
📖 John 14:6 – "I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me."
🔥 Jesus didn’t come to establish a religion—He came to bring people back to the Father!

❌ Religion creates rules—Jesus gives life!
❌ Religion enslaves—Jesus sets free!
❌ Religion keeps people busy—Jesus transforms hearts!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A person spends years serving a church, but deep down, they are still struggling with sin and have no true relationship with God.
👉 Why? Because they were serving a church system instead of seeking Jesus!
🚨 You cannot love your church more than you love God!

🔥 4. SIGNS YOU LOVE YOUR CHURCH MORE THAN YOU LOVE GOD
📖 Matthew 6:33 – "Seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness."
🚨 Do any of these sound like you?

❌ You defend your church more than you defend God’s Word.
❌ You blindly obey your pastor without testing what they preach.
❌ You rely on your church’s teachings instead of reading the Bible yourself.
❌ You think church attendance is more important than a personal relationship with Jesus.
❌ You would rather hear what your pastor says than what the Bible says.
🔥 If this is you, it’s time to repent and seek God FIRST!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If your church changes doctrine, will you stay, or will you follow what the Bible says?
👉 If you follow your church even when it goes against God’s Word, then your loyalty is misplaced!
🚨 YOUR CHURCH DIDN’T DIE FOR YOU—JESUS DID!

🔥 5. HOW TO LOVE GOD WITH ALL YOUR HEART, SOUL, AND MIND!
📖 Jeremiah 29:13 – "You will seek Me and find Me when you seek Me with all your heart."
🔥 If you want to truly love God FIRST, here’s what you must do:

✔️ 1. PRIORITIZE PERSONAL PRAYER & BIBLE READING! (Joshua 1:8)
✔️ 2. FOLLOW JESUS, NOT JUST A CHURCH SYSTEM! (Luke 9:23)
✔️ 3. OBEY GOD OVER RELIGIOUS TRADITIONS! (Mark 7:13)
✔️ 4. TEST EVERYTHING AGAINST SCRIPTURE! (1 Thessalonians 5:21)
✔️ 5. LIVE A HOLY LIFE OUT OF LOVE FOR GOD! (John 14:15)

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If your church tells you one thing, but the Bible says another—who will you obey?
👉 True love for God means putting His Word above everything else!
🚨 IT’S TIME TO LOVE GOD FIRST—NOT JUST YOUR CHURCH!

🔥 FINAL WARNING: CHURCH CAN’T SAVE YOU—ONLY JESUS CAN!
📖 Acts 4:12 – "Salvation is found in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to mankind by which we must be saved."

🚨 Going to church does not make you saved!
❌ Only Jesus can save you!
❌ Only Jesus is the way to the Father!
❌ Only Jesus is worthy of our worship!
🔥 LOVE GOD FIRST—THEN EVERYTHING ELSE WILL FALL INTO PLACE!
👉 ARE YOU LOVING GOD ABOVE ALL ELSE?

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO PUT GOD FIRST
"Lord Jesus, I surrender my heart, soul, and mind fully to You! Forgive me if I have put my church, traditions, or anything else above You. Help me to seek You FIRST and love You with all that I am. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
